Chapter 1045: 6 Are You The Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

Chapter 1045: Chapter 6 Are You the Great Lord? (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

“What’s going on?”

The expert from the Purple Dream Domain looked uncertain and suspicious.

Swish.

A series of terrifying attacks roared through spacetime toward Lin Yuan, arriving within mere meters of his body in an instant.

“Why hasn’t the defensive formation appeared?”

The purple-haired woman froze slightly.

She had assumed Lin Yuan walked out so confidently because he was still within the defensive formation.

But now, their attacks were about to strike Lin Yuan, yet there wasn’t the slightest trace of the formation’s aura.

“Is this a clone of that Yu Yan?” The hunched old woman glanced at the Sky Burning Court and speculated in her heart, “Whether it’s a clone or not, he’s dead for sure.”

Whoosh.

To Lin Yuan’s right, a figure emerged—a gaunt man who extended his right hand to grab Lin Yuan.

The purple-haired woman, seeing this, immediately turned away.

She didn’t need to look to know that Lin Yuan’s death was certain. The gaunt man’s physical body was reputed to be the strongest under the Great Lords of the Purple Dream Domain. In the realm of pure physical strength, he could even withstand several blows from a Great Lord and survive.

With the gaunt man this close, even the purple-haired woman felt her scalp tingle, let alone Lin Yuan, who had no chance of survival.

“Is this the strength you all dared to infiltrate with?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the gaunt man reaching out to grab him and casually flicked his right hand.

Though it was just a Primordial Spirit that walked out of the Sky Burning Court, because of the secret technique “Illusory Reality,” the Primordial Spirit had transformed into a fleshly body. Its combat power wasn’t much weaker than his true physical form.

Various Physical Body Divine Abilities, the thirteenth-level inheritance “Infinite Void,” and even the Fierce Sun Divine Body—everything could still be cultivated in spirit form.

Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!

With Lin Yuan’s casual hand wave…

The gaunt man, who had already reached him, suddenly showed a drastic change in expression, turning deathly pale and coughing up several mouthfuls of blood. His body and soul began to collapse until a faint green glow enveloped him and barely stabilized his injuries. He retreated violently backward.

This scene left the purple-haired woman and the other Purple Dream Domain experts watching in stunned disbelief.

“Senior Brother Kuang Zhen…?” The purple-haired woman couldn’t believe what she had just witnessed. “He was severely injured instantly? If not for the Tears of Life gifted by the master, wouldn’t he already be dead?”

Senior Brother Kuang Zhen’s physical body was unmatched in the Purple Dream Domain. Even a Great Lord’s attack might not kill him.

And yet, with a mere flick of Lin Yuan’s hand, he had practically already died once?

The purple-haired woman couldn’t accept this. Even if Lin Yuan had hidden strategies to confidently walk out of the Sky Burning Court, she had assumed it would involve defensive measures—something, for instance, to evade the gaunt man’s attacks.

But this? What was this?

Rumble.

At this moment, the other Purple Dream Domain experts’ attacks also descended. However, all of their assaults instantly ignited upon brushing against the edges of Lin Yuan’s garments, burning unceasingly until they were completely annihilated.

“Run! He’s a Great Lord, he’s a Great Lord!!”

Not far away, the gaunt man, Senior Brother Kuang Zhen, transmitted a message to the purple-haired woman and the others without hesitation and fled without looking back.

If not for the life-saving treasure, the Tears of Life, he would have been completely annihilated just now by Lin Yuan’s casual hand wave.

For someone to casually land a blow that inflicted such devastating damage—there was no explanation other than that Lin Yuan was a Great Lord. That’s why the gaunt man transmitted such a warning.

At this moment, only one thought occupied his mind: escape.

As for why the youngest disciple of Lord Qingfen would be revealed as a Great Lord—there simply wasn’t time to think about it.

“A Great Lord?”

The purple-haired woman’s pupils contracted, and she likewise prepared to flee.

Buzz!!!

The surrounding spacetime began to condense from all directions, hardening like amber and trapping all the Purple Dream Domain experts within.

“Trying to run?”

Lin Yuan stepped forward, appearing behind the gaunt man, and pressed down with his palm.

The gaunt man’s physical body began to collapse again. This time, without the Tears of Life to save him, only a wisp of his soul remained, which Lin Yuan suppressed and collected.

Swish.

Lin Yuan waved his hand once more.

Among the remaining dozen or so Purple Dream Domain experts, nine of their physical bodies instantly ignited and began burning uncontrollably, turning to ashes in the blink of an eye.

From the moment Lin Yuan had voluntarily stepped out of the Sky Burning Court until now, after making only a few moves, more than half of the dozen or so Half-step Great Lords from the Purple Dream Domain had perished, leaving only a few survivors like the purple-haired woman, barely holding on with their life-saving treasures.

Even so, the remaining Purple Dream Domain experts who survived couldn’t hide their faces of terror. In front of Lin Yuan, they couldn’t even talk about resistance, let alone mount a challenge—they were as fragile as ants.

“Is that the Fierce Sun Divine Fire? Which Great Lord are you?”

The purple-haired woman looked terrified as she witnessed her fellow disciples being reduced to ashes.

The Fierce Sun Divine Fire of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country could only be wielded by those who had awakened the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

To fully awaken the Fierce Sun Divine Body? That required at least the peak of the Sovereign Realm, and even then, only an unparalleled prodigy could hope to achieve it.

Someone like Lin Yuan, who could slay Half-step Great Lords as easily as butchering chickens, was almost certainly a Great Lord.

A Great Lord who had awakened the Fierce Sun Divine Body?

It was known that not all Great Lords could awaken such a body, but those who did were exceedingly difficult to contend with.

“So much pointless chatter.” Lin Yuan struck again, reaching for the remaining Purple Dream Domain experts who were still alive.

Rumble!

Lin Yuan’s arm suddenly expanded, piercing through the void and appearing directly in front of the remaining Purple Dream Domain experts.

These experts, trapped within Lin Yuan’s spacetime cage, had their movements drastically slowed down.

On top of that, they had already used up all their life-saving treasures to ward off the Fierce Sun Divine Fire earlier.

Now, faced with Lin Yuan’s grasp, they could do nothing but watch as their physical bodies were pierced through,

their souls suppressed, and ultimately collected by Lin Yuan at will.

Buzz!

The purple-haired woman faced Lin Yuan’s grasp as well.

From the surface, Lin Yuan’s attack seemed unremarkable, even slow.

But to the purple-haired woman, it enveloped all spacetime.

No matter how she tried to evade or resist, it was completely futile,

as though her fate was already sealed—to be pierced through by this grasp.

…

At the core of Qingfen City’s most critical formation.

Feng Wanxing sat cross-legged, diligently obeying Lord Qingfen’s orders to guard the location.

“Hmm?”

“Over there?”

Feng Wanxing noticed something and abruptly lifted his head to look in the direction of the Sky Burning Court.

At that moment, he sensed a violent fluctuation in spacetime emanating from that location.

“Not good!” Feng Wanxing’s expression instantly changed to one of panic. “The junior disciple is in danger!”
